robustness.note: The branch estimator follows the wall within R = L_e/3 of the vertex and is inflated by wall thickness / segmentation jitter; the chord estimator (straight edges between vertices) is the pre-declared primary. Both are reported; the straight-edge froth model itself has an irreducible chord-angle SD of ~10 deg because a straight-sided pentagon cannot have three 120-degree angles.

secondary_specimen.reading: Thompson's Fig. 124 regime: three-fold meeting holds, angles are spread by growth anisotropy

notes: The mean tri-junction angle is 120 degrees by identity (alpha+beta+gamma=360); the verdict rests on the dispersion about 120 and on the three-fold fraction.
Modern Commons specimens are not Thompson's own figures; the claim names no species, so they are specimens of the claim, not analogues of a named species, and are labelled as modern.
Thompson's Figs. 103/124 are hand drawings: angles measured on them test his depiction, not a photograph.
